generated_from: ISED BAI PMF questionnaire; CED 2024-2028 incubator/accelerator guide; PacifiCan funding-program glossary; BAI template v5 (D-18). See docs/reporting-anchors.md.
notes: The union of the cited public frameworks, expressed as fields the impactOS data contract can populate. The BAI template is one export of this profile; organisations may extend it. This is one iteration, a starting point.

fields.label: Stage of growth
fields.derivation: Company position on its track, mapped to the funder stage via tracks.json funder_stage.

fields.label: Founder counts by demographic
fields.derivation: Counted per person and rolled up per company; never inferred.

fields.label: Diverse-group membership
fields.derivation: PacifiCan diverse groups, recorded per person.

fields.label: Support programs attended
fields.derivation: Derived from a company's cohort memberships.

fields.label: Businesses assisted
fields.derivation: Distinct companies with at least one cohort membership in the reporting period.

fields.label: Average coaching/mentoring hours per business
fields.derivation: Sum of coaching-session interaction hours divided by businesses assisted.

fields.label: Jobs created
fields.derivation: FTEs added over the period, per PacifiCan FTE definition.

fields.label: Jobs maintained
fields.derivation: FTEs that would be lost without the project (PacifiCan definition of maintained).

fields.label: Total funding received
fields.derivation: Sum of funding_event amounts to date.

fields.label: Average funding received
fields.derivation: Total funding received divided by businesses assisted.

fields.label: Survival rate
fields.derivation: Share of assisted companies still active after a defined interval.
